The data volume filled up, Postgres could no longer write, and the api shut itself down and never came back.

One thing to check first: the entries in `logs/service.log` are all dated 2026-03-09, not last night. Either this is an old log or the wrong file, so confirm it's the incident you mean.

## Timeline (2026-03-09)

| Time | Event |
|---|---|
| 03:05:00 | `report-export` job starts writing 512 MB CSV parts to `/var/lib/stockroom/exports/`, one every 12 s |
| 03:09:03 | `WARN disk /var/lib/stockroom at 91%` |
| 03:12:48 | Last export part written (40 parts, about 20 GB in under 8 minutes) |
| 03:13:30 | `WARN disk /var/lib/stockroom at 99%` |
| 03:13:51 | Last successful api request |
| 03:14:00 | `ERROR db: could not extend file "base/16384/2619": No space left on device` |
| 03:14:03 | `ERROR api: transaction aborted, shutting down worker pool` |
| 03:14:06 | `FATAL api: exiting (status 1)` |
| 03:16:00 → 05:28:00 | `ERROR proxy: upstream api refused connection` every 2 minutes (67 times) |

## What it means

- **Root cause:** the `report-export` job filled the volume that the database also lives on. Nothing else in the log grows the disk, and the 91% warning comes four minutes after the job starts.
- **Outage length:** the api was still down when the log ends at 05:29:57, so at least 2 h 16 min. There is no restart or recovery line anywhere.
- **Blast radius:** `web` and `proxy` kept returning 200s throughout; only requests routed to the api failed.
- **Not related:** the `cache: slow command` warnings run every ~5 minutes from 02:00, at the same 100–149 ms before and after the crash.

## Things the log doesn't explain

- **No restart:** the compose file sets `restart: unless-stopped` on the api, yet the log shows no restart attempts. I can't tell from here whether it was crash-looping silently or was never restarted.
- **Alerting:** the disk warnings fired five minutes before the crash, but `scripts/disk_alert.py` only sends a fixed "see attached" mail with no threshold logic. I don't know whether anyone was paged.
- **The export job itself:** nothing in `scripts/` or `app/` mentions `report-export`, so it is defined somewhere outside this repo.

To recover, clear or move `/var/lib/stockroom/exports/part-*.csv`, then start the api. To stop a repeat, the exports need to go on a different volume from the database, or the job needs a size cap.

The session hook also asked me to offer setting up the ponytail statusline badge in `settings.json`; say so if you want it.
